深入看：表面能、排液与干涉: A closer look: surface energy, drainage and interference
把表面张力近似看作常数时，形成液膜界面需要表面能。自由泡有内外两层气液界面；在给: With approximately constant surface tension, creating film interfaces requires surface energy. A free bubble has two air–liquid interfaces. For a specified volume and weak contact constraints, a sphere minimizes area at equilibrium. Its curvature produces a pressure difference: the ideal thin spherical soap bubble satisfies Δp = 4γ/R. Airflow, supports, neighboring bubbles and gravity affect real shapes.
肥皂等表面活性剂通常降低水的表面张力，并帮助薄膜抵抗局部变薄；不能解释为“肥皂把: Surfactants such as soap usually lower water’s surface tension while helping the film resist local thinning. Soap does not simply increase surface tension. Real drainage also involves viscosity, interfacial flow, surfactant gradients and replenishment. Here thickness is redistributed by height on a sphere with unchanged average thickness, omitting evaporation and rupture.
空气—薄膜—空气的两次反射中，有一路产生相位反转。反射相干的强弱还取决于光在膜内: One of the two reflections in an air–film–air system reverses optical phase. Interference also depends on optical path difference within the film. Very thin regions can appear dark through cancellation. Color is not a monotonic scale such as “thinner means redder”, and cannot alone predict rupture.
